say: "Welcome to the meadow. Feel how the wind leans on the grass? That is Gale."
choices: Can you make something from my harvest?
Could you sew me something from hopper hide?

say: "Face the way you want to go, then:"
1 - Dash: rush forward on the wind.
2 - Gust: blow Gust Hoppers away from you.
3 - Wind Scythe: cut grass, herbs and flowers to harvest them.
"Each one draws on your Gale energy, the green bar. It returns quickly while you breathe the open air."
"Breeze Reeds hold a little wind. Mark them as supply in your pack and they lend you the current you cannot channel alone. Ask too much of them and they burst."
"Bring me three Meadow Herbs and three Windflower Petals and I will brew you a Gale Tonic."
"There. A Gale Tonic: it mends wounds and fills your lungs with wind."
"I need three Meadow Herbs from the terrace above and three Windflower Petals from by the pond."
"Feathers for lining, fibre for thread. There: a Hopperhide Vest. Wear it (I) and the meadow will bite less."
"Five Hopper Feathers and five Grass Fibers, and I will sew you a vest."
"Stairs are for carrying things. The wind is for getting places."
choices: Teach me to move on the wind.

say: "Step to a cliff edge and face it. F lets the wind carry you down - Featherfall. G throws you up a ledge - Upward Jump."
"Watch the ground ahead of you: a marker shows where you would land, or why you can't."
"A narrow ledge you can jump. The terrace face here is too tall until you have practised."
"Up on the lookout, east of here, Skyreeds grow where nobody without wind can reach. Their stems are the best Breeze Reeds."
"Hoppers love the terrace edge. A Gust at the right moment sends them tumbling to the meadow."
